_comment: Operationalizable NFR targets only. Each row is a hard ceiling that perf:diff flags as a regression even if the baseline drifts.

rows.anchorsNfr: DESIGN_SPEC.md NFR #1 (open a 5 MB JSON file without freezing the page)
rows.rationale: Longest task during a 5 MB paste must stay under 200 ms so the UI thread does not freeze. Other DESIGN_SPEC NFRs (TTI<2s on 4G; api/ p95<200ms) are deferred to follow-up issues; their measurement requires CI infra not in scope for v1.
